name: Views Autocomplete API demo
description: Example submodule wiring two demo Views to the core search block via views_autocomplete_api.
project_description: Views Autocomplete API demo is an example submodule of the Views Autocomplete API project. It ships two example Views (search_auto_publish, search_auto_unpublish) and a hook_form_search_block_form_alter that converts the core search block's field into a Views-driven autocomplete. On install it also creates two sample article nodes. It exists purely to demonstrate the parent module and is not intended for production sites.
